# dsh-intelligent-UI
An independent open-source presentation plugin for the official DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with an of
fline UI component library built in. This repository contains the intelligent renderer, silent front
end-development tools and themes in one project and one installable plugin. It builds and tests on i
ts own and uses the official application unchanged.
The historical package name **`@lisihao/dsh-solar-intelligent-experience-platform`**, RPC/tool names
and data directory are retained for installed-user compatibility. They do not introduce a dependenc
y on another project. The public preview is distributed as a prebuilt GitHub Release archive. npm pu
blication is not required; community-market listing depends on the catalog maintainers accepting its
on is not required; community-market listing depends on the catalog maintainers accepting its entry.
**内置组件智能**：同一个插件包含 Uiverse 离线组件库、静默前端开发 skill 和自动内容渲染。开发时可按需检索 3,802 个真实组件；展示图表、任务、记录和流程时，自动使用 15 个经
过适配验证的组件，并保留原文、数据与来源。
## Built-in component intelligence
Uiverse component reuse is a core feature of intelligent UI, shared by frontend development and live
content presentation.
| Path | Automatic behavior | Source evidence |
| Intelligent content rendering | Local analyzers recognize charts, tasks, records and flows; semant
ic roles select approved card/control adapters while keeping the chosen theme. Empryo and other v1 t
hemes participate automatically; v2 component themes keep their selection and v3 ASCII uses native c
ontrols by default. | Fifteen compiled source-backed adaptations carry original component IDs and SH

A-256 on rendered elements. |
| Frontend development | The model discovers the bundled skill for fro
ntend/UI tasks, searches suitable components and reads their complete source before adapting new con
trols. Existing suitable project controls take precedence. | All **3,802 components in 11 categories

** from the official Galaxy snapshot, with authors, license, original source and hashes. |
| Source-
preserving review | Original/comparison views retain text, tables, units and qualifications; isolate
d previews can be inspected within the authorized task. | The same pinned archive backs lookup and l
ive adapter provenance. |
The archive pin is `adbd2adde0a299a3956ea288fb444ec01891ca41`, dated 2024-09-02. It is a complete sn
apshot of that archive, rather than a current full-site mirror. Live presentation uses the curated c
ompiled adaptations; the full archive supplies development lookup and sandbox previews. OpenUI still
owns its chart marks and native form internals.
The component capability is silent: it adds no library sidebar, page or popup. Its model-invocable s
kill loads on demand through DSH's official skill mechanism. `solar_ui_search`, `solar_ui_source` an
d `solar_ui_preview` are included in this plugin; a separately installed component plugin is unneces
sary. Normal tool history and the owner's permissions remain in effect. Actual model selection varie
s with the model and task; runtime semantic layout selection itself requires no extra model call.

## Canvas UI integration (development candidate)
The `solar_ui_canvas_search` tool discovers the 35 effects in a fixed Canvas UI catalog for frontend
work, including their WebGL factory inputs, cleanup requirements and the appropriate experimental D
SH client adapter where one exists. Discovery does not prove runtime availability. The optional `sol
arExperienceUi.loadCanvasEffect(slug)` client service obtains the requested WebGL factory from that
exact upstream revision, checks its source hashes and builds it locally. The plugin package does not
redistribute the upstream component sources. This requires access to the official source on first u
se after a Host restart; failure leaves the original content readable. Canvas UI's MIT + Commons Cla
use terms, including its component-redistribution restriction, remain in force.
The object-effect integration targets explicitly identified GLB records (Ink by default; declared or
source-evidenced coding and project-management contexts select ASCII and Glass), and validated, sou
rce-declared PNG/JPEG illustrations (Ink by default). Under the GPU ASCII theme, eligible GLB models
and illustrations use ASCII Object. Standalone Markdown images explicitly labeled as illustrations
can use the same image path. Each illustration keeps a separate, protected original beside its effec
t. These object effects observe visibility, reduced-motion preferences and a shared GPU budget. Sepa
rately, the GPU ASCII theme can project supported visible charts, icons and images through the share
d Asciify graphics atlas described below. Original content remains available; rendering does not cal
graphics atlas described below. Original content remains available; rendering does not call a model.

## Local data browser

## What it does
- Optional takeover of standard assistant/tool output, generated content and user-message text. User
messages retain the host-owned attachments, timestamps, copy controls and actions; the same path al
so covers steering messages. User text is rendered from its original raw slice as data; user-scoped
Markdown whitespace preserves prose/list soft line breaks and pre/code wrapping without inheriting t
he host bubble's broad preformatted layout. It is not handed to OpenUI, MCP Apps or a model for exec
ution. One conversation-level **显示** control switches visual, original and comparison views for outp

ut.
- Settings offers an optional **分类导航** mode with fixed category tabs, a native list for the sele
cted group and the original settings page. It reuses Intelligent UI theme tokens with compact spacin
g and a consistent outline icon for every entry, and has no dropdown or persistent popup. Every regi
stered setting remains reachable, including future entries under Other. A version-bounded, reversibl
e DOM/CSS adapter preserves the original shell, launcher, handlers and page components; unmatched la
youts restore native navigation with a visible error. Page changes keep the saved mode; **取消分类导航** r

estores the flat list. See ownership and compatibility.
